_about: Zeroed Recovery Playbook of /tools/zeroed/ (F-13). Log-off checklist (6 items or fewer), ordered recovery steps, what still counts, and the farm section. Peace shield costs and durations have no fact card (known gap): the page says pending measurement and never gives numbers.

logoff.text: Raise a peace shield if a kill event or a war is running.
logoff.detail: Shield costs and durations: pending measurement. We have no fact card on them yet.
Wounded troops beyond hospital capacity die.

evidence.A08-0502: Wounded troops beyond hospital capacity die

logoff.text: Keep raw resources at or under your storehouse protection.
logoff.detail: Anything above it can be plundered. Keep the rest as resource items, which can't be.

evidence.A03-0006: Storehouse protects raw resources from plunder up to a per-level cap
evidence.A03-0007: Resources held as items cannot be plundered and have no storage limit

logoff.text: Leave gatherers only in your alliance resource center.
logoff.detail: Armies gathering there cannot be attacked.

evidence.A03-0012: armies gathering there cannot be attacked

logoff.text: On a farm during a kill event, send the surplus to your main first.
logoff.detail: Big raw stockpiles on farms attract raids. Only the amount above storehouse protection can be sent.

evidence.A13-0005: transfer surplus to main and keep exposed raw resources within storehouse protection
evidence.A03-0030: only resources above the protected amount are transferable

logoff.text: In Season of Conquest, keep your city inside your alliance territory at home.
logoff.detail: Since 1.1.03, cities inside another alliance's territory in the home kingdom can't be attacked once the kingdom is in Season of Conquest.

evidence.C04-0014: governors can no longer attack cities inside other alliances' territory in the Home Kingdom

steps.title: Stop it happening again tonight
steps.text: Run the log-off checklist above before you close the game, even with nothing left to lose: resources keep coming in.

steps.title: Find out why it happened
steps.text: Kingdoms use zeroing as their harshest penalty, after a kick and a deadline to migrate, for things like missed DKP or a broken MGE deal. If that is your case, talk to leadership or plan a move; if it was a war, read on.

evidence.B03-0005: Used for missed DKP, breaking MGE agreements, refusing orders, or unwanted power

steps.title: Heal before you retrain
steps.text: Heal the wounded still in your hospital, then keep capacity and healing speedups ready for the next fight.

evidence.A08-0502: keep hospitals large and clear before fights

steps.title: Rebuild a T4 core, not T5
steps.text: T5 heals cost much more than T4. Without a steady economy, fight with T4 and keep a T4 reserve.

evidence.A08-0505: accounts without steady economy should keep fighting with T4 and maintain a T4 reserve

steps.title: Field fewer, complete marches
steps.text: Three good marches, or even one complete march, do more than five weak ones and cost less to heal.

evidence.A08-0504: ~3 best marches or one complete march are more useful and cheaper to heal

steps.title: Feed the rebuild from your farm
steps.text: Send farm resources to your main through the Trading Post. The trip uses a march queue, takes travel time and pays a tax that falls as the Trading Post levels up.

steps.title: Save for scored events
steps.text: Keep speedups, resource items and AP items for scored events and KvK instead of spending them as they come.

evidence.A11-0501: save speedups, resources (as items), AP potions for scoring events and KvK healing

stillCounts.text: Dead troops are usually the heaviest part of DKP. Your kingdom sets the rules, and some count deaths from a badly traded zeroing day as zero, so check yours.

evidence.B08-0001: deaths on a day you were zeroed in a 'terrible trade' count as 0

stillCounts.text: In newer Season of Conquest Lost Kingdoms, troops you lose also earn Acclaim, scaled by troop level.

evidence.C04-0015: earn Acclaim from severe wounds/kills inflicted and suffered

stillCounts.text: The Hall of Heroes returns part of what you spent healing in the Lost Kingdom when it ends.

evidence.C04-0028: returns part of the resources spent healing in the Lost Kingdom at its end

stillCounts.text: Resource items and gems were never at risk: they can't be plundered.

evidence.A03-0007: Gems cannot be plundered in any form

farm.text: Farms with big raw stockpiles at a low City Hall attract raids, most of all during kill events. Move the surplus to your main and keep what stays within storehouse protection.

evidence.A13-0005: Farms holding large raw stockpiles at low CH attract raids, especially during kill events

farm.text: Some players zero their own farm for MGE or kill points. The guide that reports it advises against it unless you need it for a commander.

evidence.A13-0005: the guide author advises against it unless needed for a commander

farm.text: Keep the farm close to your main: Trading Post trips walk there and back.

evidence.A03-0026: Keep farm cities close to the main to shorten trips
